## Vontier - Software Engineer II

🔗 [Apply](https://careers.vontier.com/us/en/job/GIL012292)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer II developing automated tank gauge and fueling infrastructure software for Gilbarco Veeder-Root. Applying modern technology stacks, Agile practices, and object-oriented programming.
Software Engineer II developing fueling infrastructure software for Gilbarco Veeder-Root
- Salary: $96,800 - $124,600 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Java, C++
- Design, develop, and execute software solutions for Automated Tank Gauge and related platforms
- Bring knowledge of newer technology stacks and frameworks and identify where they should be applied
- Help the team get up to speed on newer technologies
- Use Agile methodology experience to improve Agile team operations
- Collaborate with peers, electrical and mechanical development teams, quality assurance, and others
- Mentor junior engineers on design and coding best practices
- Transfer technical knowledge about newer technologies
- Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
- 3–5 years of experience developing software in object-oriented programming languages
- Ideally C++ or Java experience
- Project leadership experience is preferred
- Experience with continuous integration and automated test technologies is useful
- Experience with REST APIs and JSON is useful
- Experience with AWS or Azure and associated services is useful
- Experience with Agile methodologies

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer II developing automated tank gauge and fueling infrastructure software for Gilbarco Veeder-Root. Applying modern technology stacks, Agile practices, and object-oriented programming.
Software Engineer II developing fueling infrastructure software for Gilbarco Veeder-Root
Role description:
• Design, develop, and execute software solutions for Automated Tank Gauge and related platforms
• Bring knowledge of newer technology stacks and frameworks and identify where they should be applied
• Help the team get up to speed on newer technologies
• Use Agile methodology experience to improve Agile team operations
• Collaborate with peers, electrical and mechanical development teams, quality assurance, and others
• Mentor junior engineers on design and coding best practices
• Transfer technical knowledge about newer technologies
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
• 3–5 years of experience developing software in object-oriented programming languages
• Ideally C++ or Java experience
• Project leadership experience is preferred
• Experience with continuous integration and automated test technologies is useful
• Experience with REST APIs and JSON is useful
• Experience with AWS or Azure and associated services is useful
• Experience with Agile methodologies
• Ability to collaborate with electrical and mechanical development teams and quality assurance
